issues.description: getCategoryLabel has no stated precondition; behavior on empty/malformed input is unreasoned.
issues.detail: The function accepts any string but never specifies its precondition. For id="", split yields [""] and returns "". For id="--" it returns "  ". No invariant is documented. Either restrict the domain (validated category id) and refuse other inputs, or document the postcondition for the degenerate cases. Currently TESTED-NOT-PROVED.

issues.description: Heuristic capitalization silently breaks the prior explicit mapping's postcondition.
issues.detail: The old adapter guaranteed "trustboundaries" -> "Trust Boundaries" and "forensics-ready" -> "Forensics Ready". The new heuristic produces "Trustboundaries" (length>3, single token) and only coincidentally handles the hyphenated case. The replacement weakens a previously total function into a partial heuristic without proof of equivalence on the known input set. SMUGGLED regression.

issues.description: SEVERITY_ORDER now has two keys mapping to value 4, violating its implicit invariant.
issues.detail: SEVERITY_ORDER is treated as a bijection from severity name to rank. Adding Info: 4 alongside Informational: 4 breaks the invariant that ranks are unique and that reverse-lookup is well-defined. Any consumer that inverts this map, sorts stably by rank, or counts distinct severities will silently misbehave. State the spec before mutating shared constants.

issues.description: handleValueChange treats "" and "all" as equivalent without justification; dead branch hides intent.
issues.detail: Select's value is "all" by construction (placeholder uses "all"); the empty-string branch is unreachable under the stated precondition. Either prove a path where value==="" arises and document it, or remove the branch. Defensive code as substitute for a stated precondition is DEFENSIVE-AS-SUBSTITUTE.

issues.description: horizontal-bar-chart recomputes maxValue inside the map loop; invariant should be lifted.
issues.detail: maxValue and the percentage-fallback expressions are loop-invariant with respect to the iteration index but are recomputed per item. Hoist them outside the map to make the invariant explicit and the cost linear rather than quadratic in the worst case. Minor, but the loop body currently obscures what is constant.

issues.description: Removing category__in from DEFAULT_FILTER_BADGES while adding the filter elsewhere is unexplained.
issues.detail: The PR adds a Category filter to findings yet deletes its active-badge config. Either active badges are now generated from a different source (state the invariant linking filter registration to badge rendering) or this is a regression where the user can filter by category and see no badge. The diff does not prove which.

review.summary: The PR is TESTED-NOT-PROVED. The replacement of an explicit, total CATEGORY_LABELS map with a heuristic getCategoryLabel weakens a previously well-specified function: known inputs like "trustboundaries" no longer round-trip to "Trust Boundaries", and the function's precondition on input shape is nowhere stated. SEVERITY_ORDER gains a duplicate-value key, silently breaking its bijection invariant. A defensive branch in CategorySelector substitutes for a stated precondition on Select values. None of these are catastrophic, but none have been reasoned about; the author should state spec/invariant for the shared utilities before merge.
